mapper.select: SELECT , t1.mrb01_start_hour||':'||t1.mrb01_start_min||' ~ '||t1.mrb01_close_hour||':'||t1.mrb01_close_min AS time FROM mrb01_booking t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.mrb01_company_id = #{companyId} AND TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(),'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_CHAR(COALESCE(t1.mrb01_booking_close_dt, t1.mrb01_booking_dt),'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.mrb01_parent_id = 0 ORDER BY t1.mrb01_booking_dt, COALESCE(t1.mrb01_booking_close_dt, t1.mrb01_booking_dt) DESC, f_cdnm('MeetingRoomCode', t1.mrb01_room_cd, t1.mrb01_company_id, f_sysdate()) COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

timestamp)) AS date) AS booking_date , COALESCE(f_emp_kor_nm(mrb01_emp_id), ' ') AS emp_nm , COALESCE(mrb01_subject, ' ') AS subject , COALESCE(f_cdnm('MeetingRoomCode', mrb01_room_cd, AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT max(x.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code x WHERE x.sys09_code_kind_id = c.sys09_code_kind_id AND x.sys09_company_id = c.sys09_company_id AND x.sys09_code = c.sys09_code AS timestamp)),'YYYYMMDD')||'190000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY 3
SELECT , t1.mrb01_start_hour||':'||t1.mrb01_start_min||' ~ '||t1.mrb01_close_hour||':'||t1.mrb01_close_min AS time FROM mrb01_booking t1 WHERE t1.mrb01_booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT mrb01_company_id FROM mrb01_booking WHERE mrb01_booking_id = #{bookingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrb01_booking (mrb01_booking_id, mrb01_company_id, mrb01_emp_id, mrb01_subject, mrb01_room_cd, mrb01_booking_dt, mrb01_start_hour, mrb01_start_min, mrb01_close_hour, mrb01_close_min, mrb01_attendance, mrb01_forwarding, mrb01_parent_id, mrb01_booking_close_dt) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{companyId}, #{req.empId}, #{req.subject}, #{req.roomCd}, CAST(#{bookingDate} AS timestamp), #{req.startHour}, #{req.startMin}, #{req.closeHour}, #{req.closeMin}, #{req.attendance}, #{req.forwarding}, #{parentId}, CAST(#{closeDate} AS timestamp))
mapper.update: UPDATE mrb01_booking SET mrb01_emp_id = #{req.empId}, mrb01_subject = #{req.subject}, mrb01_room_cd = #{req.roomCd}, mrb01_booking_dt = CAST(#{bookingDate} AS timestamp), mrb01_start_hour = #{req.startHour}, mrb01_start_min = #{req.startMin}, mrb01_close_hour = #{req.closeHour}, mrb01_close_min = #{req.closeMin}, mrb01_attendance = #{req.attendance}, mrb01_forwarding = #{req.forwarding}, mrb01_parent_id = #{parentId}, mrb01_booking_close_dt = CAST(#{closeDate} AS timestamp) WHERE mrb01_booking_id = #{bookingId} AND mrb01_company_id = #{companyId}
